Field Label: Recording status, or the reduced recording
Field Note: With file storage on this holds a marker -- the size, hash and document id of the recording that was filed. With file storage off, or when filing failed, it holds the recording itself, reduced to fit: a text field takes 65,535 bytes and a full result is larger, so the choice is reduced or truncated, and a document cut off mid-element is worth nothing. A value beginning with "<" is a recording; anything else is a marker.
